searchText: b"h — api request/response primitives (geelooy/api/social/helper/api/) low level request/response policy wrappers used by social routes, named in the sephirah style used across this codebase. files binahrequestbody.js, binahrequestquery.js — decode and validate incoming request bodies and query values. binahrequestvaluedecoder.js — shared value decoding used by the binah request wrappers. gevurahroutemethodpolicy.js — enforces allowed http methods per route. hodapimetadata.js — attaches api metadata (caller, version, timing) to responses. malchusresponsegarments.js — shapes final response envelopes ("garments") so every route returns a consistent success/error structure. yesodsocialidentityresolver.js — resolves the acting social identity (user/alias) behind a request. what it does gives route handlers one place to: parse request input safely, reject wrong methods, know who is acting, and emit uniform responses with metadata attached.

searchText: b"h — assets (geelooy/api/social/helper/assets/) asset upload, storage, manifesting, and access control for social content (post attachments, editor uploads, private message media). key files assetupload.js, multipart.js — multipart upload handling. assetcopy.js, assetcopysource.js — copy assets between sources. assetmanifest.js, assetpaths.js, privatemessageassetmanifestsource.js — manifest tracking and path resolution. assetpolicy.js, assetratelimit.js — upload policy and per user rate limiting. assetbindings.js — binds assets to comment/post sections. publicassetaccess.js vs privatemessageassetaccess.js (+ proofs: privatemessageassetproof.js, privatemessageimageassetaccess) — public access layer and gated private message access with image manifest proofs. test/ — copy/binding test vessels and suites. what it does handles the full asset lifecycle: parse uploads, enforce policy and rate limits, record manifests, and serve assets — with a strict split between public assets and private message assets, which require access proofs.
